founded.description: The supported project year, or a reviewed first-use estimate documented in the collection README. Required by repository coverage checks. Do not substitute a token reservation or an unrelated older member; consumers must not infer it from the oldest issuance.

variation_of.description: Marks this canonical collection as variations of one parent work: the parent and subassets registered under it (alternate art, prints, editions). Marketplaces keep it browsable but do not feature it alongside ordinary collections.

founded_date.description: Optional evidenced project date, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, matching founded. Preserve source precision; never manufacture a day or copy asset registration automatically. Document evidence and estimates in README.

editorial_type.description: Optional public editorial classification, independent of kind and primary membership. Set: works intended together. Series: named artistic sequence/body. Curation: retrospective selection. Document evidence in README. Omit for ordinary collections; variation_of already identifies variations.
